body.title: Verify end-to-end recovery cancellation and canonical publication
body.summary: Integrate production start/read/progress/reply/status/resume/cancel through real domain and canonical stores with deterministic provider/controller fixtures.
acceptanceChecks: Per-block ACKs survive provider/transport/daemon interruption; exact concurrent retries converge and late/revoked replies cannot create a terminal result.
Pinned source/contracts/BUILD/party changes and edited canonical heads refuse; frozen lost-ACK publication reconciles without rerunning judgments.
Incomplete/failed execution produces no successful CR while accountable WARN/BLOCK findings and pending usage remain intact.

tests.name: Crash concurrent resume cancel and frozen publication recover without duplicate execution
